Pool = `query({type: t, cost: c+step})` (shipped sets by default, R380/R1420, non-token default, never the running card R387); empty → nearest higher cost present, random among ties; still empty → unchanged (R129). Hook: chosen def via `find_instance`; fused (two ingredients, see `fuse.rs`) → no effects. Count = `ctx.embiggened` (copy `c035_prep.rs`) ? `param(copy2)` : `param(copy)`. Emit `shuffle_into({def_id, count})` (fresh by construction). Radiant: same call plus `memory: {propagation: 1}`, then `for_each_card` over the library filtering that memory key, each `upgrade({instanceId, times: 1})` (silent in deck, R440; copy `c008_withering_storm.rs` id-sweep shape).
6. #32: `cry` returns `upgrade({scope:{side:any,zones:[field]},times:param(times)})` then `degrade({scope:{side:any base/enemy radiant,zones:[field]},times:param(times2)})`. Tradable is catalog data.
7. #51: `targets: [TargetDecl{aim: Harm, …{side:any,of:[unit]}}]` — Units only (R3557002). Hook: side spec = self/enemy by target controller. Effects: `dormant_target({target: chosen, turns: param(count)})` + `delay({at:{phase:start,player:<that side>}, turns: param(count), data:{instanceId}, watch:id, mark})`. Script `delayed` hook (copy `c023_reoccurring_dream.rs`): missing instance → nothing (R174); controller == caster → `upgrade({instanceId,times:param(times)})` else `degrade({instanceId,times:param(times2)})`. The delay fires after that turn's awakening (`turn.rs`: brittle → awaken → delayed).
8. #68: `cry`: `discover_from_library({step:"visions",filter:{type:[Spell]},count:3})` (copy `c051_kys_private_tutor.rs` reveal shape; REVEAL_COUNT const). Resume step: `add_to_hand({defId: discovered def, radiant})`, Radiant additionally costing 1 less via `add_to_hand`'s discount rider (verify field in `add_to_hand.rs`; precedents #39/#23-radiant), never below 0 (R65). Empty pool → nothing (R129); full hand burns (§2.4).
9. #76: consts `AYY="stinkyscapeplus-076-1"`, `ASTEROID="stinkyscape-169"`, loop `param(summons)` (3). Hook draws each via `ctx.rng.pick(&[AYY, ASTEROID])` (E9: repeats allowed, pool smaller than count), emitting `summon({def_id: pick, radiant: radiant && pick==AYY, keywords: [Cloaked], backrow_first: pick==AYY})`. Asteroids always base, unit row.

14. #104: Spell (brief SP5). Target one permanent `of:[unit,backrow]` any side, aim matching `c024_polymorph.rs`. `cry`: single-card `transform_cost_step` equivalent for the chosen id, step 1/2. Temporary is catalog data; add `end_of_turn` + graveyard `bounce` self-return exactly copying `c023_reoccurring_dream.rs` (`return_to_hand_at_end_of_turn` flag pattern).
15. #105: `Cry`: `transform_cost_step({scope:{side:self,zones:[field],types:[Unit],excludeSelf:true}, step: 1/2})`. Stats are catalog data.
16. #158: `static_flags.cast_on_draw` + `cry`: `cast_random({query: Fixed({type:[Spell]}), count: 1, radiant})` (copy `c154_chaos_accelerator.rs`; default pool = shipped non-token Spells, never itself R387; random targets by default, nothing pauses).
17. Write the thirteen §8.12 rows in table order, mirroring the S04/S05/S11 row style.

## Risks

- Determinism/replay: all draws through `ctx.rng` inside hooks/effects (never at effect-build time); the Ayys mix is hook-drawn, then fixed-def summons — same discipline as `c008`/`c032-M`.
- Hidden information: hand/deck buffs stay silent (R440); Discover reveals only to the caster; no view changes, no wire changes (delay data is internal JSON, not `view.rs`).
- Ordering: the Chains rider depends on delayed-start running after awakening — pinned by `turn.rs` order and asserted in test (Awakened precedes rider events).
- Scope discipline: B-Patch/Z-Patch scopes exclude the resolving spell naturally (zones field/hand); Dormant cards are passed by hostile walks (R1839000).
